title: SSP candidate preflight — exhaustive offline verification and zero-DT-change BOOT gate
overall_reason: Multiple gates FAIL or are BLOCKED: (1) the kernel source tree is contaminated with 28 unrelated netfilter files, (2) no clean pinned kernel has been built (no .config, no Image), (3) pack-ssp-boot.py has a broken FDT-discovery heuristic that cannot repack this device (which has NO appended DTB), and (4) no software-only alternative has been proven to require a kernel flash. A single FAIL means NO FLASH.
no_zero_brick_probability_assertion: No assertion of zero brick probability is made. Any future flash is covered by the owner's BOOT-only TWRP agreement and bounded hardware-trial authorization, not by this report.

results.test_nuxel_bbd_flash: PASS (TL framing, RPC encode, F1 records, RX decode)

results.note: 68 original + 9 NEW fixtures (real-source-unavailable and stale-data recovery, in test_source_availability_and_stale.py)

G_KERNEL_CLEAN_INPUTS.detail: The kernel working tree is NOT clean: 28 unrelated netfilter files are modified by no patch in the repo. Violates 'no unrelated patch changes'.

G_KERNEL_BUILD_EXACT_PINNED.detail: Exact pinned kernel NOT built. No .config generated, no arch/arm64/boot/Image produced. Build cannot proceed until G_KERNEL_CLEAN_INPUTS passes.

G_EMBEDDED_FIRMWARE_IDENTITY.detail: Verified firmware identity against real bytes (not documentation): bbd_patch_file_beyond.h -> asic=0x004775b0, blob_length=438895, patch_address=0x00800161, crc32_ieee=93d35bb4, kernel_export_sha256=0b53f3b04b..., blob_sha256=56e8b1ea4b34...

G_BOOT_DONOR_REVALIDATION.detail: Donor BOOT revalidated LIVE from running handset root@10.11.12.99 (uname 4.14.253-gf7194c1d15ed-dirty). Fresh read-only dd+sha256 of sda12/13/14/15 all match the Stage-01 historical hashes byte-for-byte.

G_BOOT_PACK_VERIFY.detail: tools/s10plus/pack-ssp-boot.py CANNOT repack this device. Its FDT-discovery heuristic (donor.find(0xD00DFEED) after ramdisk) assumes an appended DTB tail; this device has NO appended DTB (external dtb/dtbo partitions sda12/sda13). Running it on the donor raises 'cannot locate the appended DTB region'. The always-true fallback 'donor[cand - min(cand, PAGE):cand] or True' is also a degenerate branch. A working packager for this device must not search for an FDT tail.

evidence.verify_boot_image: header_size=1648, kernel_size=45848584, ramdisk_size=2424832, appended_dtb_count=0, 'no valid appended BOOT FDT' (expected/correct)
evidence.unpack_boot_image: offsets kernel=2048 ramdisk=45852672 dtb=48277504; dtb_size=9394176 = ALL ZERO partition slack (verified all zeros, 0 FDT magic bytes)

G_BOOT_BYTEEXACT_TAIL.detail: There is NO appended/embedded DTB/hash tail to preserve: the region after ramdisk (9394176 bytes) is 100% zero partition slack with zero FDT magic occurrences. A correct kernel-only repack would preserve only the header (1648 bytes) + ramdisk bytes byte-for-byte and zero-fill the remaining slack. The byte-equality requirement is therefore trivially satisfiable, but cannot be demonstrated because no candidate kernel exists and the packer is broken (G_BOOT_PACK_VERIFY).

G_BOOT_DTB_DTBO_PARTITION_HASHES.detail: dtb (sda12) and dtbo (sda13) partition hashes recorded read-only immediately before any flash (no flash performed). Both UNCHANGED and byte-identical to Stage-01. androidboot.dtbo_idx=9 records the bootloader-selected DTBO; no dtc/dtbo output was changed in any deployed package (no package was deployed).

G_BOOT_ROLLBACK_STAGING.detail: HOST-side known-good rollback seed captured and size+digest verified: /tmp/nuxel-ssp-preflight/boot-sda14-fresh.img (57671680 bytes, sha256 0e6aa34c... == live sda14). A SECOND TWRP-accessible copy + dual-endpoint byte verification has NOT been established (no recovery boot performed; TWRP accessibility not reconfirmed). This gate is therefore NOT fully satisfied for a rollback receipt.

G_SOFTWARE_ONLY_ALTERNATIVE.detail: The installed kernel (0020+0023) already exposes the full userspace passthrough transport: /dev/ttyBCM (10,91), /dev/bbd_sensor (236,1), /dev/bbd_control (236,2), /dev/bbd_patch (236,3), and the write-only /sys/class/sensors/ssp_sensor/nuxel_bringup ABI. The native userspace tools (nuxel_bbd_flash.c --flash, nuxel_bbd_download.c) target exactly these nodes and could drive the firmware download WITHOUT a kernel flash. The 0027 kernel-side downloader (nuxel_ssp_dl_*) is therefore NOT proven necessary, and flashing a new kernel merely to change where the already-testable protocol parser runs is avoided. Note: the userspace path is NOT yet proven to produce RX (live diag still rx=0), so this is an alternative to pursue, not a proven fix.

known_remaining_hardware_risks: The MCU (BCM47752KUB1G) has never produced RX in response to the 184-byte TX — root cause (cold-start timing vs electrical vs protocol) remains unresolved.
The vendor lhd runtime is ARCHIVE_ONLY (expected SHA256 6362e80d...); it cannot be re-verified against live bytes in this session.
autobaud 32-vs-36 reconciliation (kernel 32 vs lhd VA 0xdfe4 36) remains unresolved.
Any future BOOT flash requires the owner's BOOT-only TWRP agreement and bounded hardware-trial authorization; this report grants nothing.

boot_image_parser_comparison.second_result: kernel_off=2048, ramdisk_off=45852672, kernel_addr=0x10008000, ramdisk_addr=0x11000000, tags_addr=0x10000100; dtb region (48277504+) = 9394176 bytes ALL ZERO slack (verified). next_stage_only_if_all_pass: Move to stage 05 under owner's BOOT-only TWRP agreement and bounded hardware-trial authorization ONLY after G_KERNEL_CLEAN_INPUTS, G_KERNEL_BUILD_EXACT_PINNED, G_BOOT_PACK_VERIFY, and G_BOOT_ROLLBACK_STAGING all individually PASS. They do not all pass in this round.
